components.name: Entry
components.layout: 100svh centered dark grid, top metadata, belt loading rail, loading text and delayed enter action
components.behavior: Preloads red, black, white full-belt WebP via Image objects; percentage is completed count / 3. On all load/error completions waits until at least 2500ms since start then shows locked and Enter. An image error still counts as complete. Enter reveals application without route change.
states: loading: text LOADING ASSET NN/03 and no button
ready: locked label and enter button
image preload errors are not separately exposed
components.responsive: Belt rail 74vw max 830px; 85vw <=600px; metadata inset 28px, mobile 18px.

components.name: SiteHeader / Wordmark / Navigation
components.purpose: Sticky brand and section navigation with language switch
components.layout: 69px sticky full-width flex header, 4vw gutters, brand left and horizontal nav right
elements: language toggle button showing ع in English and EN in Arabic
states: no current-section, hover, or active navigation styles defined
language button has base border and padding but no bespoke hover
components.responsive: At <=600px drops nav links third onward; BUILD stays visible; language button remains.

components.name: Masthead
components.layout: Large minimum-height section with fluid top padding and decorative 01 at lower right
components.responsive: Headline and padding fluid via clamp; inline gutter 18px mobile.

components.name: BeltSections / ProductCard
components.layout: Three stacked article sections, each product min-height 550px; image spans both grid columns; copy bottom right with left divider
elements: belt image with color-specific alt text
components.behavior: Size finder action links to #size. No cart or purchase action.
components.responsive: Image width clamp(530px, 86vw, 1300px), left margin -8vw and rotate(-8deg); mobile image width 720px; product copy moves to bottom, spans grid and margin-left 45%.

components.name: OutfitSwitcher / Builder
components.purpose: Interactive CSS scene, outfit and belt preview
components.layout: Builder heading, scene preview, 3 fieldsets in desktop 3-column grid
components.visuals: Scene background is CSS texture/gradient. Model head, body and garment are CSS silhouette; belt is image absolutely positioned using outfit data x/y/scale. Outfit top/name fields are data but top is not rendered.
components.states: Selected button receives .active red background and white text. No disabled/loading/error states.
components.responsive: Scene height min(73vw,600px), mobile 530px; model 255x500px centered, bottom -15px; controls stack at <=600px.

components.name: SizeFinder
components.purpose: Suggest belt size and hole based on waist measurement
components.layout: Two-column bordered grid; left numeric input/unit selector; right size/hole result
components.logic: Converts inches to centimeters with 2.54 multiplier. Finds inclusive min/max size range; if none matches, falls back to chart item at index 1. Chooses closest value in that item's holes array to converted waist and displays its 1-based index.
components.states: Selected unit button .active; result updates immediately. Empty input becomes numeric 0. No explicit validation/error/empty state; out-of-range result falls back to chart's second entry.
components.responsive: Two equal columns desktop; one column at <=600px; divider becomes horizontal top border.

components.name: Drop
components.purpose: Prototype countdown and simulated inventory display
components.layout: Dark two-column section, countdown left, remaining inventory right separated by border
components.behavior: now ticks every second; countdown is max(0, startsAt-now), displayed DD:HH:MM:SS. Remaining units decrement by one at random interval 7000-13000ms and clamp to zero. Intervals are cleaned up on unmount. Values are client-side simulated, not server data.
components.responsive: One column <=600px; remaining block gets top border and top padding.

components.name: Members
components.purpose: Local member number wall and opt-out join form
components.layout: Two-column grid, two-column wall at left and form at right
components.behavior: Form prevents default. Blank trimmed name returns with no feedback. Creates initials from whitespace-separated name parts, next number = max current number + 1. If hide checked, existing wall remains and notice shows assigned ID plus privacy label; otherwise prepends member entry. Clears name after successful nonblank submit. State is ephemeral and resets on reload.
states: empty form has no explicit message
no success/error validation for malformed names
components.responsive: Member grid one column and wall single column <=600px.

components.name: PaymentOptions
components.layout: Section with kicker and wrapping horizontal numbered list
components.behavior: Display-only text; no links, payment form or checkout behavior.

inconsistenciesAndRisks: --ash is defined but unused in the inspected stylesheet.
Rubik is requested by the font import but no CSS rule uses it.
The top navigation omits the Members section even though it has id=members.
At mobile breakpoint nav hides SIZE and DROP links; their sections remain reachable by scrolling/product action.
Size out-of-range inputs silently use the second chart row; hole selection then compares waist centimeters directly to chart hole values.
Arabic document direction is set, but most layout behavior remains CSS grid/flex plus limited logical properties; complete Arabic visual correctness needs runtime review.
Entry preload counts errors as completed and still reveals Enter; it does not provide a broken-asset state.
Drop inventory and member submissions are simulated/local only; no real stock or persistence integration exists.
Several interaction states are implicit only: no explicit focus, disabled, loading or form error styling beyond browser defaults and selected active buttons.
